messages.title: Meet the Enshrouded modding community
messages.message: Talk mods, swap ideas, or ask for a hand when something is confusing. The Enshrouded Modding Discord brings players and mod authors together. Joining is completely optional, and you are welcome to just listen in first.

messages.title: Welcome — and thank you for being here
messages.message: ShroudForge grew from work already happening in the Enshrouded modding community. Brabb3l's EML and kfc-parser opened important doors, and Shroudtopia showed how runtime mods could be loaded, unloaded, and configured while the game was running. I am grateful to everyone who shared tools, examples, discoveries, and time. ShroudForge brings mod management, asset preparation, and runtime features together, with the goal of keeping documented EML mods usable too. If you are new here, the guide will help you find your way around and get started.

messages.title: Thinking about making your own mod?
messages.message: Every mod starts with mod.json: its name, version, author, dependencies, and the features it needs. ShroudForge-specific switches, settings, buttons, and links live in the optional extended.mod.json. The Modloader can display those settings for players, and your Lua code can read them through the ShroudForge API. You do not need to learn every field at once: start with the working Hello Ember template, then use the interactive guide to see how a setting appears in the UI.

messages.title: Your mods and what they do 🧩
messages.message:
ShroudForge includes optional mods for gameplay, crafting, and building. They are not all active automatically. Open Installed Mods on the left to choose a mod, read its description, adjust settings, and check requirements or update notes.

GAMEPLAY AND INVENTORY
• Auto Stamina Refill restores your stamina.
• Unlimited Flight removes the flight time limit. It requires Auto Stamina Refill, so keep both available and enabled.
• Infinite Item Split keeps the original stack when splitting items and also affects other inventory actions.
• Infinite Item Use prevents supported items from being consumed when used.
• No Fall Damage prevents health loss from falling.
• No Resource Cost removes resource use in supported building, crafting, and item-use actions.

CRAFTING AND BLUEPRINTS
• Production Time lets you choose the base duration for timed production. World speed settings still apply. Prepare asset changes before launching the game.
• Unlock Blueprints changes supported recipe unlock requirements to the first Flame Altar hint.

WORLD BUILDING
• World Editor lets you capture, save, rotate, and place parts of a world. Its guide explains setup and controls.

A mod only has an effect when it is enabled and supported for that situation. Some asset changes need preparation before the next game start.

messages.title: When do changes take effect?
messages.message: Your choices are saved as soon as you apply them. What happens next depends on the mod: runtime-only mods can apply settings live when their code reads the current value from a lifecycle or action callback. Asset changes are prepared before the next game start, so close Enshrouded before preparing them. If a mod's status says that a restart is needed, the change is saved and waiting for the next session.

messages.title: Report issues and help improve ShroudForge
messages.message: Found a bug, a confusing message, or a rough edge? I would love to hear about it. A useful report includes your Enshrouded and ShroudForge versions, which mods were enabled, what you expected to happen, what actually happened, and the steps that reproduce it. A short log excerpt can help too. Please remove personal information before posting logs, and report a mod's own behavior to its author when appropriate.

messages.title: Support ShroudForge
messages.message: I build ShroudForge because I love seeing what this community makes possible in Enshrouded. The most valuable support is already here: people trying the loader, making mods, sharing ideas, and taking time to report problems. If you would also like to chip in financially, you can buy me a coffee. There is absolutely no pressure — being here and making things together is a big deal on its own. Thank you.

mod.install.success.title: {name} installed
mod.install.success.message: Version {version} is now in your mods folder. Open the mod page to check its status, enable it, and see whether it has settings or setup notes. Some changes need the next game start before you can see them.

mod.update.success.title: {name} updated
mod.update.success.message: Updated from {previousVersion} to {version}. Your mod package is ready. Take a look at the changelog below for what changed. If the update replaced package files, check your settings before launching the game.

mod.remove.success.title: {name} removed
mod.remove.success.message: Version {version} was moved to the ShroudForge recycle bin and removed from your active mods folder. The package is kept in ShroudForge's local trash folder in case you need the files again.

system.update.title: ShroudForge {version} is available
system.update.message: There is a new ShroudForge version ready. You can review what changed, then prepare the update here. The verified installer waits until Enshrouded is closed before replacing the loader files.

system.error.title: Update check failed
system.error.message: I could not reach the update service, so I could not check for a newer version. Your installed ShroudForge files are unchanged. Check your connection and try again when you are ready.

system.staged.title: System update queued
system.staged.message: The update was downloaded and verified, and is waiting for Enshrouded to close. Once the game exits, the updater can finish replacing the ShroudForge files.
